compiled_state.title: merge-to-main-pr.sh: remove 3 broken llm-api-call.sh default paths
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
DD2: zero active in-tree references to deleted llm-api-call.sh

## Context
merge-to-main-pr.sh has 3 functions with defaults that reference the deleted llm-api-call.sh:
- Line ~701: local _llm_cmd="${_LLM_DISPATCH_CMD:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/llm-api-call.sh}"
- Line ~995: local _llm_cmd="${_RESOLVE_CONFLICTS_LLM_CMD:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/llm-api-call.sh}"
- Line ~1121: local _llm_cmd="${_REMEDIATE_LLM_CMD:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/llm-api-call.sh}"

These use the env var override mechanism already. The fix: remove the default fallback to llm-api-call.sh. When no env var is set, the function should fail with a clear "LLM not configured" message instead of trying to exec a deleted script.

## Implementation
For each of the 3 occurrences, change from:
```bash
local _llm_cmd="${_LLM_DISPATCH_CMD:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/llm-api-call.sh}"
```
To:
```bash
# compat-shim: llm-api-call.sh was deleted in S3; set _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD to provide an LLM helper
local _llm_cmd="${_LLM_DISPATCH_CMD:-}"
if [[ -z "$_llm_cmd" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD not set and llm-api-call.sh was deleted" >&2
    return 1
fi
```
(Similar pattern for _RESOLVE_CONFLICTS_LLM_CMD and _REMEDIATE_LLM_CMD)

Note: The test at tests/integration/test-merge-to-main-pr-thread-resolution.sh already sets
_LLM_DISPATCH_CMD via env var, so the fix will not break that test.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] No llm-api-call.sh active references in merge-to-main-pr.sh
  Verify: ! grep -n "llm-api-call.sh" plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh | grep -v "^[0-9]*:#"
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: bash -n plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] Integration test still passes (uses _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD env var already)
  Verify: bash tests/integration/test-merge-to-main-pr-thread-resolution.sh 2>/dev/null || true

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
